question: Please help me find the names of top 5 players with the highest average runs per match in season 5, along with their batting averages.
sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    SUM(bbs.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bbb.match_id) AS matches_played,
    ROUND(1.0 * SUM(bbs.runs_scored) / COUNT(DISTINCT bbb.match_id), 2) AS batting_average
FROM match m
JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON m.match_id = bbb.match_id
JOIN batsman_scored bbs ON bbb.match_id = bbs.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bbs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bbs.ball_id
JOIN player p ON bbb.striker = p.player_id
WHERE m.season_id = 5
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY batting_average DESC
LIMIT 5

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- Calculate batting average per player in season 5
-- A player plays a match if they appear in ball_by_ball for that match (as striker or non_striker)
WITH season5_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id
    FROM match
    WHERE season_id = 5
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bbb.striker as player_id,
        bbs.runs_scored,
        bbb.match_id
    FROM season5_matches s5
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON s5.match_id = bbb.match_id
    JOIN batsman_scored bbs ON bbb.match_id = bbs.match_id 
        AND bbb.over_id = bbs.over_id 
        AND bbb.ball_id = bbs.ball_id
),
player_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        SUM(runsscored) as total_runs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as matches_played
    FROM player_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    pt.total_runs,
    pt.matches_played,
    1.0 * pt.total_runs / pt.matches_played as batting_average
FROM player_totals pt
JOIN player p ON pt.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY batting_average DESC
LIMIT 5", "preview_rows": 10}
